plain_english_policy: Increase federal funding allocated as block grants to states for K-12 education, specifically to support hiring more teachers.
evidence_quote: Increase funding for block grants to states to help them hire additional teachers.
review_reason: The policy is procedurally neutral in terms of left/right framing, as it focuses on administrative implementation (block grants) rather than ideological priorities.
